text: True or False: General Extensional Mereology (GEM) contains a null individual — a 'mereological empty object' that is part of every object, exactly analogous to the empty set ∅.
explanation: Classical mereology admits NO null individual; even Weak Supplementation refutes one in any domain with more than one object. This is a central contrast with set theory, where ∅ exists and is unique — corresponding to the bottom element Tarski's theorem deletes. So the statement is false.
